title: FlashOffloading: Low-Latency KV Cache Offloading for Long-Context LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2611.07542v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In large language model (LLM) serving systems, the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with sequence length and concurrency, so long-context inference easily hits the high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity wall and results in low concurrency. Offloading the KV cache to host dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) frees HBM space and raises concurrency, but the additional cache management and host-to-device (H2D) load overhead inflates inference latency, higher concurrency fails to translate into effective throughput. We present FlashOffloading, a host-DRAM-centric inference architecture that fully offloads the KV cache in both the prefill and decode phases. FlashOffloading builds rolling HBM cache for prefill, a hot cache for decode, a reverse sparse index with zero extra miss-lookup overhead, and a compute--load overlapped kernel, optimizing KV offloading latency across the entire pipeline and delivering throughput gains under a time-per-outp

translated_title: FlashOffloading：面向长上下文大语言模型服务的低延迟KV缓存卸载
translated_abstract: 在大型语言模型（LLM）服务系统中，键值（KV）缓存随序列长度和并发数线性增长，因此长上下文推理容易触及高带宽内存（HBM）的容量瓶颈，导致并发度低下。将KV缓存卸载到主机动态随机存取内存（DRAM）可以释放HBM空间并提高并发度，但额外的缓存管理和主机到设备（H2D）的加载开销会推高推理延迟，使得更高的并发度无法转化为有效的吞吐量。我们提出FlashOffloading，一种以主机DRAM为中心的推理架构，在预填充和解码两个阶段完全卸载KV缓存。FlashOffloading为预填充阶段构建滚动HBM缓存，为解码阶段构建热缓存，构建了具有零额外缺失查找开销的反向稀疏索引，以及计算-加载重叠内核，在整个流水线上优化KV缓存卸载延迟，并在每个输出token时间（TPOT）约束下带来吞吐量提升。
tldr: FlashOffloading提出一种以主机DRAM为中心的推理架构，通过滚动HBM缓存、解码热缓存、零开销反向稀疏索引和计算-加载重叠内核，在预填充与解码阶段完全卸载KV缓存，实现长上下文LLM服务中低延迟下的并发度与吞吐量提升。
en_tdlr: FlashOffloading is a host-DRAM-centric inference architecture that fully offloads the KV cache in both prefill and decode phases using a rolling HBM cache, a decode hot cache, a zero-overhead reverse sparse index, and compute-load overlapped kernels, improving concurrency and throughput for long-context LLM serving at low latency.
